tasks.notes: Comment-label inconsistency in the new banner region of fleet/tests/test_sandbox_boot_merge.mjs. The banner's "WHERE EACH LEG LIVES" paragraph states that legs (a)–(d) and M6 are the tests under the banner, while (e) and (f) are the pre-existing tests read in place — but the section header above the contract test reads `// ── (f) M6: the contract names all three bodies ──`, reusing leg letter (f), which the same banner has just assigned to the existing `not mergeable` scenario [M5]. The test's own title is correctly `[strict-405 M6]`; only the section header is mislabelled. In a file that carries four parallel numberings and leans on exact leg labels, this is worth correcting to e.g. `// ── M6: the contract names all three bodies ──`.; Comment-label inconsistency in the new banner region of `fleet/tests/test_sandbox_boot_merge.mjs`. The strict-405 banner defines leg (f) as the pre-existing `not mergeable` scenario [M5] and lists M6 as a separate clause with no leg letter, but the section header introducing the CONTRACT.md test reads `// ── (f) M6: the contract names all three bodies ──`, which re-uses (f) for M6. The test itself and its assertion prefix (`[strict-405 M6]`) are correct; only the divider mislabels. In a file where the banner/leg numbering is the navigational contract across four numberings, this is worth a one-word fix.

The suite, the sim sentinel, the three scoped CONTRACT.md greps and the docs test all ran green in the integrated evidence.
